svg.title: Forgot / Reset Password (three client steps, three endpoints)

g.text: Forgot / Reset Password (three client steps, three endpoints)
resetotp = generateOTP(); otpPurpose = "reset"; resetotpExpiry = now + 10 min; save()
200 "Code is correct. Set your new password."
[missing field / confirm mismatch / length < 8 / not strong]
400 "Wrong code. Please start Forgot Password again."
clear resetotp, expiry, otpPurpose; save() (bcrypt via pre-save)
Backend does not limit OTP attempts (see implementation-gaps.md).
